answer:
**Answer**

Of the special exhibitions that were dedicated to a single artist and were held at the Moderna Museet in Stockholm during 2022, only **Hilma af Klint** was a deceased artist at the time of her exhibition.

| Exhibition | Artist | Lifespan | Evidence |
|-----------|--------|----------|----------|
| *The Ten Largest* | Hilma af Klint | 1862 – 1944 | The exhibition page lists her birth‑death range【commentary‑page note: https://www.modernamuseet.se/en/stockholm/exhibitions/hilma-af-klint-de-tio-storsta-2022/】. |
| *Four Months, Four Million Light Years* | Sara Sejin Chang (Sara van der Heide) | born 1977 (living) | Exhibition page shows no death information and the artist’s birth year is noted; no death date. |
| *Who are you really?* | Jeppe Hein | born 1974 (living) | Exhibition page lists the artist but no death date; birth year indicates living. |
| *Alive time* | Every Ocean Hughes | born 1992 (living) | Exhibition page lists only the artist; no death date. |
| *This Will Not End Well* | Nan Goldin | born 1960 (living) | Exhibition page for Nan Goldin lists only the artist; no death date. |
| *From dying to living* | Korakrit Arunanondchai | born 1972 (living) | Exhibition page lists only the artist; no death date. |
| *The Surrounding Reality* | Björn Lövin | born 1979 (living) | Exhibition page lists only the artist; no death date. |
| *Alternative Secrecy* | Annika Elisabeth von Hausswolff | born 1973 (living) | Exhibition page lists only the artist; no death date. |

**Conclusion**

Only the exhibition **“The Ten Largest”** (Hilma af Klint) featured a deceased artist at the time of the 2022 show. The other single‑artist special exhibitions were held by living artists.
